name: Dark keynote: a stage, one lime accent
for: product and AI-tool explainers, launch-style reveals, anything with a hero number

motion.ease: fast out, a small overshoot, landing on the beat
motion.note: a UI expanding or collapsing is the cut; red is used until the turn, then the accent

texture.grid: hairlines at 3% white on a 48 px pitch

sound.mood: marimba and vibes; true silence before the key hit

source: colour roles and caption size after lemo-opuscar's dark-keynote notes (MIT); muted and the display size are ours
